_comment: A picture per culture topic on /culture, drawn as self-hosted OpenMoji (scripts/fetch-openmoji.mjs). Keyed by topic id in kultur.json (the ids are kept from the older courses: duzen-siezen is tu or vous, pfand is greetings, anmeldung is proof of address, and so on; see docs/content-plan.md §5.8); the three extras by their own names; the /culture/codes-sociaux topics under "insider". Emoji changes for French: anmeldung 📄 (proof of address), ausbildung 🎓 (apprenticeship, university), vereine 🙌 (associations, volunteering), foederalismus 🏛️ (State and decentralisation).
